title: Tughral Tughan Khan
note: Banglapedia biography by M Delwar Hussain on the governor active in the 1230s and 1240s. It summarizes later historiography and should be distinguished from Minhaj-i-Siraj's contemporary narrative.
whyItMatters: The entry gives a modern synthesis of Tughral Tughan Khan's recognition by Razia, his campaign toward Kara, the Orissa conflict, and his transfer from Lakhnauti in 1245; its dates and interpretation can be compared with Juzjani's account.
